KA KTIEN LAMPHRANG

KI SYIEM BA SHAPHANG SEPNGI JONG 
KA KHASI HILLS

Kat kum ka khanatang la don kajingong 
ba u Blei u la ibit ban ai noh ha u ’Lei 
Shyllong ban synshar ia ka Khyrim kaba long 
kawei na ki Hima ha ri Khasi. Sha palat jong 
ka Hima Shyllong lane Khyrim kaba don sha- 
phang Mihngi bad baroh ki lum kaba don ba ka 
thain sepngi kaba iar shaduh ki Lum Garo Hills 
bad kiba ha ri-Lhor jong ka Susang-Durgapur 
jong ka District Mymensing jong ka Bengal lah 
ban jer kyrteng kum ka ‘Western Khasi Hills’, 
namar ba katto katne ka bynta jong ki rilum 
ki la leit hap ha ka jingsynshar jong ki khasi 
ha kaba khadduh. Ia ka khanatang jong ki 
Khyrim kumba la kdew haneng ryngkat lang 
bad ia ki niam ki rukom ba iadei ha ka sain 
pyrthei bad ka thoh ka tar jong ki hima khasi 
jong kane ka thain ka pyni ba ki Syiem sep- 
ngi ki la don la slem bah, la kumno kumno 
ruh naduh kito ki por barim bajah tang ba 
ka long shabar ne sha palat ki pud jong ka 
ri khasi. Ka la paw shai ba ym shym la don 
uno uno ruh u ’lei Syiem uba la wan paw 
ha kato ka jaka, ia kaba ngi la khot mynta 
ka thain sepngi jong ka ri Khasi. Nalor nang- 
ta, ia kane ka jaka la buhai shnong da shibun 
ki riewlum Garo bad da kiwei lawei de ki

2

riewlum Tibeto Burman bad ki Khasi ruh. 
Kumta ka la pynlong ia ki nongshong shnong 
jong kane ka thain ba kin tieng ia ki khasi 
namar ba ki lah ban knieh ia kane ka jaka na 
ki nongshong shnong Tibeto-Burman ba tynrai, 
kata kum ki Garo bad kiwei kiwei de.

Wat lada ia ki bynta lum jong ka thain 
sepngi ki la long lehse kiba khadduh ban buhai 
shnong da ki khasi, ia ka jingbuhai shnong 
jong ki riew iaid wir jong ka jaid khasi ha kane 
ka thain ka lah ban long naduh ka por barim. 
Ki khanatang jong ka jingsynshar Syiem ha kane 
ka thain ki pyni ba ka rukom synshar ba 
nyngkong eh hangne ka long kumjuh kumba 
ka long shawei shawei, ka sdang na ka jing- 
long Lyngdoh bad jinglong Basan. Kum ban 
shu ong la don shibun bha ki shnong rit kiba 
synshar da ki paitbah ba la ialam khmat da 
u Lyngdoh lane u Basan kum ha ka rukom 
u Syiem ha shuwa ba kine ki shnong ba la.it- 
luid kin iamynjur ban ia tylli kum kawei ka 
shnong hapoh uwei u Syiem, ia uba ki shait jied 
napdeng ki nongwei kiba don ka snam Syiem.

Ki daw bad ki jingjia ba bun ki la pyn- 
long ia ki Khasi-Pnar ban leit phetwir na 
mihngi sha sepngi bad ban seng ia ki shnong 
ki thaw hapdeng jong ki riewlum Tibeto-Bur- 
man, ka lah ban long lehse ka jing bym don 
ki khyndew jhum ha ki Jylla tynrai jong ki. 
Haba ia nujor bad ki phang mihngi jong ka 
ri lum ki don shibun ka khyndew na ka 
bynta ban rep jhum, namar ka thung ka tep-

3

ka dei ka kam kaba kongsan jong ki. Teng- 
teng pat dei tang ka jingbym don ka jingiada 
ka la pynlong ia shibun ki iing ki sem bad ki 
jaid ki kynja jong ki Khasi-Pnar ban leit wad 
jaka rieh noh sha kane ka bynta jong ka ri 
ka bym pat shym la tip bha, kata sha kine ki 
thain sepngi.

Dei ha kane ka rukom ia shibun ki shnong 
ki thaw ki la seng ha ka thain sepngi bad 
shibun ki shnong ki la ia snoh lang khnang 
ban ia tylli kawei. Kumta ki la jied ia u 
Syiem kum u khlieh duh jong ka hima barit 
jong ki. Ha kane ka rukom shibun bha ki 
hima ki la wan mih ha ka thain Sepngi jong 
ka Khasi Hills. Shibun ki hima bad ki Syeim 
ki la wan mih ha ka juk pdeng kum ka 
Khadsawphra lane Nongkhlaw, ka Nongstoin, 
ka Langrin. Ka Maram lane Maharam, ka 
Mawiang, ka Nongspung, ka Mawsynram, ka 
Nong Sopho lane Nobosopho, ka Malai Soh- 
mat, ka Bhowal lane Warbah, ka Byrung, ka 
Nongwah-Rani, Ka Myriaw lane Mo, ka Ram- 
brai ka Jyrngam lane Surigam bad ka Nurtung.

Ki khadwei tylli ki hima ba la ai kyrteng 
ha shawa ki don ha ki khappud jong ka ri- 
thor Sylhet. Napdeng jong ki, kiba heh duh, 
dei ka Khadsawphra bad ka Nongstoin, ki iar 
naduh ka rithor jong ka Kamrup bad Goal- 
para ba shatei shaduh ka rithor jong ka Sylhet, 
katba kiwei kiwei ki hima rit ha ki pud jong 
ki ruh ki don la ki khyndew ki shyiap hi

4

ki rithor jong ka Sylhet bad Kamrup. Lehse 
hadien ba ki la seng ia la ki jong ki hima 
ha ki ri-lum, ki Syiem khasi jong ka thain 
sepngi ki lah ban ioh ia ki khyndew ki Shyiap 
ba seisoh ha ki rithor kiba hajan jong ki da 
kaba leit phetwir lane da kaba jop thma. Kat 
kum ka jingbuh jingkhein jong ki phareng ia 
ka spah snem ba khadphra, ki khasi ki la ioh 
haduh kumba shispah laiphew hynniew tylli 
ki shnong tang ha ka rithor Sylhet. Ia ki khasi 
ba shong ha kine ki shnong ki phareng ki 
khot ia ki, ki ‘Bengallee Cosseahs’ namar wad 
lada ki dei ki khasi, hynrei ki kren ia ka ktien 
Bengallee bad bud rub ia ki niam ki rukom 
jong ki Bengallee Hindu jong ki. Ia kito ki hima 
ba don shaphang sepngi jong ka Khasi Hills, ki 
briew na rithor sylhet ki tip ia ka kum ki Lum 
Laur. La khot ia ki kumta lehse namar ba ha 
kata ka por la don kawei ka hima Hindu ba 
la khot ka Laur ha rithor ba markhap ia ka 
Sylhet ba don sharum jong ka Khasi Hills, 
kaba ka jingsynshar jong ka ka la iar shaduh 
palat jong ki rithor ba la jan kot shaduh Khasi 
Hills. Ka lah ban long ba ki khasi ki la jop 
ia shi-bynta jong ki rilum bad ki rithor na ki 
Raja jong ka Laur. Kum ka jingmih nangta la 
don bunsien ki thma hapdeng ka Laur bad 
ki Syiem khasi. Ynda ki phareng ki la ioh ia 
ka Laur ha ka spah snem ba khadphra, ki shem 
ba u syiem jong kato ka ri u ieng ia leh thma 
barobor bad ki Syiem khasi jong ka thain sepngi. 
Wat la katta nalor ki jingialeh pvrshah ba man 
ka teng ha ka khappud ki khasi bad ki briew

5

jong ki rithor hynrei ki kwah ba ka jingsuk 
kan don hapdeng jong ki.

Kine ki san tylli ki Syiemship Khasi, ka 
Rani, ka Myriaw, ka Rambrai, ka Jyrngam bad 
ka Nurtung ki don ha ki khappud jong ka 
Kamrup, nalor kata, ka Nongkhlaw bad ka 
Nongstoin ruh ki la ioh shibun bah ki pud 
ki sam ha rithor Kamrup. la kine ki khyndew 
ki shyiap ha rithor la khot ki duars namar 
lyngba jong ki ki riewlum ki shait wan hiar 
sha rithor na ka bynta ka khaii ka pateng bad 
kiwei kiwei ki jingthmu. Ki don khyndai tylli 
kum kita ki duars ba la ioh kynti ki khasi 
ha Kamrup. Ia ka thymmei bad ka jingiar 
jong ki Syiemship Khasi jong kane ka jaka 
un sa ai ha ki sla ba bud shadien.

6

SECTION l

KA H1MA KHADSAWPHRA LANE 
NONGKHLAW

la ka hima Khadsawphra hadien la tip ia 
ka kum ka Hima Nongkhlaw, ka don shaphang 
sepngi jong ka Hima Shillong lane Khyrim. Ki 
Syiem jong ka Khyrim ki don ka jingiadei ba 
iajan bad ki Syiem jong ka Khadsawphra 
kumjuh ruh bad ki briew jong ka.

Ka jingsdang bad ka jingseng ia ka :

Ka paw ba ha shuwa ka jingseng ia ka 
Syiemship Khadsawphra, la don phra lylli ki 
shnong kaba kawei pa-kawei na ki-ka dei ka 
hima laitluid ba hapoh ki Lyngdoh kum ki 
nongialam jong ki. Kine ki shnong ki dang 
don haduh mynta ka sngi, ki dei 1. ka Mawthang- 
syiar; 2. Mawsenna; 3. Nongum ; 4. Nong- 
kseh; 5. Marong; 6. Marsum; 7. Nongkhlaw; 
8. Lawriat. Ia kine ki shnong la pynlong kum 
ka thymmei jong ka Syiemship Khadsawphra 
ba pawnam.

Ngi don ka daw ba biang ban ngeit ba ia 
kine ki shnong la shem nyngkong eh da ki nong- 
phetwir ba na ka Hima Khyrim, kata da ki 
Khyrim kumba ki Jaintia ki khot ia ki briew 
jong kato ka hima. la ka ktien Khyrim la 
shim na ka kyrteng Khynriam. Kat kum na 
ka puriskam, la ong ba ia ka khun Syiem la 
pynrieh khnang ba kan lait na ki jingma jong 
ka thma ha Nongkhlaw lane ha ka khyndew

*

jong ki Khyriem, dei na kata ka daw ka sa ioh 
shuh da kawei ka kyrteng, ka Jat Rmen lane 
Khyriem. Nalor kane ka jingiadei ba jan bha 
hapdeng ki bricw jong ka Khyriem bad ka Nong- 
khlaw, kumba (a kdew da ka khanatang, ia ka 
kyrteng Nongkseh bad ia kito kiwei pat ki shnong 
la pynkyrteng ha ka kyrteng jong ka jaid Nong- 
khlaw ba paw khmat jong ka Khyrim. Lehse 
kane ka pyni ba ka dei ka kynhun jong ki briew 
jong ka Khyrim kiba la long ki nongseng jong ki- 
ne ki phra tylli ki shnong tynrai jong ka Khad- 
sawphra. Kat kum u Dr H. Bareh u ong ba ki 
phra tylli ki kpoh Lyngdoh jong kito ki shnong 
ki wan poi na Jaintia Hills.

Ai kan long kumba ka dei ban long, kine ki 
phra ki Lyngdoh kiba im kyrpang la ka jong ka 
jong, hynrei hadien ki la sngewdon kam ban ia 
soh Iang hapoh uwei u Syiem lane nongialam. 
Kumta la mih uwei u briew uba la paw khmat bha, 
uba kyrteng u Shajer ha Mawthang-syiar, kaba 
long kawei na ki phra tylli ki shnong ryngkat 
bad ka para jong u, ka Shaphlong ban wad spah. 
Ia une u briew la ai nam kum u nongseng ia ka 
Syiemship ha kaba sdang da kito ki phra shnong.

U SHAJER

Kajinglong jong u Shajer ha ka trei ka 
ktah ka long kaba itynnad bha. Kat kum na u 
Syiem Kine Singh (1876-1911) jong ka Nong- 
khlaw uba long u nongai jingtip ba kongsan 
bha ia ngi, u Shajer u wan sha Jaintia Hills bad 
u iadei kur bad u Raja jong ka Jaintia ba ha 
kato ka por ia uba ka kyrteng jong u ym shym

8 '

la pynpaw. Hadien ba u la iehnoh ia la ka 
ri-lum tynrai la jong, la ong ba u la shu shang 
sakma shane shatai bad la ka para katto katne 
por ha Kamrup. La ong ba ka Shaphlong 
ka la bud ia u ha kata ka jingiaid na ka daw ba 
kam ioh ia la ka spah ka phew ha Jaintia Hills.

U Shajer u la pynlut katto katne por ha 
Bar duar (Kamrup). Hangne u la ia kynduh ia 
uwei u Don Ahom uba la die noh katto katne 
ki khyndew sha u tang ba hadien pat u la kyn- 
tait noh ban ai ia ki. U Shajer bad la ka para 
ka Shaphlong kx la iehnoh noh ia ka Barduar 
bad ki la iaid shaphrang sha ki thain ri-lum, dei 
hangta u la lap ia ki phra shnong ba la jer kyrteng 
haneng ba kim don Syiem. Ki Lyngdoh ynda ki 
la sngewthuh ba kine ki dei na ka kpoh Syiem 
ki la pynlong ka Dorbar bad ki la jied ia u sha- 
jer kum u Syiem nongsynshar jong ki bad ia ka 
Shaphlong kum ka Syiem Sad.

Hadien katto katne por, u Shajer u la ialam 
ia ka kynhun shipai na la ka hima ban hiarthma 
ia ka Barduar. Kumta u la jop ia u Don Ahom 
ha ka thma bad u la knieh ia ka Barduar. Na- 
duh ba u la jop, u la pynbynta ia la ka por 
hapdeng ka hima Khasi jong u bad ka Barduar. 
U Shajer u la synshar ia la ka hima. Kumba 
katto katne snem ei ei hadien, u sa iap noh bad 
u la iehnoh ia ka kam nongialam ha ki pyrsa 
shynrang jong u kiba na ka Shaphlong.

F. Note (1) Barduar-ka long kawei na kita ki khyndai 
duar ha Kamrup, ka long kaba heh tam, ka don ba kjat 
ka hima Nongkhlaw. la kane la pynlong da u Syiem 
Nongkhlaw haduh ka por ka jingwan ki phareng.

9

KA TARIK ANTAD IA KA POR BA 
SENG IA KA HIMA

la ka kyrteng kaba nyngkong eh ia ka Hjma 
ha ka por ba ki seng ia ka ym lah ban pynthikna, 
hynrei ym don jingartatien ba u Shajer u dei 
u Syiem ba nyngkong ch jong ka hima. La 
don katto katne ki puriskam kiba thoh bad kdew 
ia ka kyrteng jong u Shajer. Ka khanatang 
ka pyniasoh ia u bad u Sahejr Nangli, u riew- 
shlur jong ka Jaintia ia uba la iathuh ba u 
la ialam noh ia la ki jong ki nongbud shabar 
ri, sha ka ri jong ki Angami Naga bad kumta 
ter ter. Bun na ki kim don jingshisha ha ka 
History.

Hynrei u Shajer u dei u briew uba ngi tip 
ha ka history, wat la katta ruh ia ka tarik ka 
jingseng ia ka Syiemship jong u kam long kaba 
suk ban wad. U Kine Singh ha ka jingthoh 
jong u sha ki phareng ha u snem 1903 A.D. u 
la iathuh ba ia ka hima Nongkhlaw ‘la pynlong 
nyngkong khadsaw pateng mynshuwa’ lait noh 
iaka jong u lehse. U Dr H. Lyngdob u la 
pyrshang ban buh jingthoh ia ka snem jingsyn- 
shar jong u Shajer hapdeng ka snem 1524 & 1554 
A.D. Hynrei ym shym la batai ia ka nongrim 
jong ka jingbuh jingthoh jong u bad ia ka 
jingbuh jong u ia ka snem synshar kam shym 
long kaba shongnia na ki bun ki daw. U Dr. 
H. Bareh u la buh ia ka por ka jingsynshar jong 
u Shajer ha pdeng 1500 & 1600 A.D., hynre 
khlem da ai ia ka nongrim ka jingmut dur jong u.

10

Kurata la pyrkhat ba kine ki riewpule bastad 
ki la dei ban pyrshang ban khein ia ka por jong 
ka snem synshar naduh ka tarik jong ki Syiem 
kiba la tip haduh ka jong kito kiba kim pal 
tip. Kum ban shu ai nuksa, ka por jong ka 
jingsynshar jong u Tirot Singh lah ban pynthi- 
kna na ki record jong ki phareng kiba iathuh 
ba u la kiew khet hadien jong u Konrai (U 
Chattra Singh ha ka record ki phareng) ha u 
snem 1826 A.D. Kat kum ka list jong ki Syiem 
Nongkhlaw ba la ai da u D. Herbert, u H. 
Lyngdoh bad u Dr H. Bareh ki don ka jingiapher 
jingmut khyndiat uwei ia uwei. Kum ban shu 
pyni nuksa, u Herbert u la iehnoh noh ia ka 
kyrteng jong u Khangthoh uba la paw ha ka list 
ba shna da u H. Lyngdoh bad u H. Bareh. Na 
u H. Bareh ngi ioh shuh sa kawei ka kyrteng, u 
Khongjer u bym shym la paw ha ka list jong kitci 
baroh arngut, kata ha ka jong u Herbert bad u H. 
Lyngdoh. Hadien ba la bishar bniah ia kito ki 
list, ngi lah ban mutdur ba ka list jong ki Syiem 
Nongsynshar naduh u Shajer haduh u Tirot Sing

11

Lada ngi shu buh antad ia ka jingsynshar 
jong ki kumba arphewsan snem ia uwei uwei 
na kine ki phra ngut ki Syiem kiba la synshar 
ha shuwa jong u Tirot Singh, kata ka tarikjong 
ka jingkiew khet jong u ka long 1826 A.D kumta, 
ngi ioh ia ka tarik jong ka 1626 A. D.-( 1826-200 
(8x25)— 200) ia kaba ngi lah ban shim kum ka 
tarik jong ka jingkiew jong u Shajer sha kajing- 
long Syiem. Haba shu buh da kumwei pat, ka 
tarik antad jong ka jingsdang ia ka Syiemship 
Nongkhlaw lane Khadsawphra ka la long ha ka 
1626 A.D. La ha kano kano ka rukom ruh, ia ka 
jingsdang ban seng ia ka hima lah ban buh ha 
ka spah snem kaba khadhynriew kumba la ai 
jingmut da u H.Lyngdoh bad u H.Bareh.

KA JINGPYNIAR IA KA HIMA NONGKHLAW

Shaphang u Nongkiewkhet ba bud ryngkhi 
hadien jong u Shajer la don artylli ki jingiathuh- 
khana puriskam ba iapher kawei ia kawei. Kat 
kum na ka khanatang, u H. Bareh ia kine ki ar- 
ngut ki khun shynrang jong ka Shaphlong, u 
Khongthoh bad u Khangjer ki dei ban long ki 
nongiohpateng jong u Shajer. La ong ba u 
Khongthoh u la jop ia ka Mawmluh, ka nongrit 
ba hajan Sohra kaba don shathic sharum bad 
kaba iajan bad ki khappud jong ka Sylhet. Kum 
ka dak ban pynsah jingkynmaw ia ka jingjop 
jong u, u la pynieng ia uwei u maw uba heh ha

12

Mawmluh, une u dang don haduh mynta bad la 
tip ia u kum maw Khongthoh. Ha kawei ka 
khanatang la ong ba u H.Lyngdoh u la iathuh ba 
ia u Shajer la bud da u Syntiew bad ia u pat la 
bud da u Khongthoh. U D. Herbert u la iamyn- 
jur bad u H.Lyngdoh, Hynrei baroh arngut kine 
ki nongthoh ki iathuh ba ia ka Mawmluh la pyn- 
ioh da u Shajer, ym dei u Khongthoh. U Khong- 
thoh wat la u wan hadien jong u Shajer, lane u 
Syntiew, hynrei u Khongthoh te imat u dei ban 
long u briew jong ka history namar u kwah ban 
pynsah jingkynmaw ia ka u pynieng khnang ha 
Mawmluh da uvvci u Mawbynna uba hch. Hyn- 
rei shaphang u Khongjer kumba la ong u dei 
u nongiohpateag jong u Khongthoh, hynrei ym 
don kano kano ruh ka jingtip shaphang jong u. 
Namar kata ngi hap ban kohnguh ba ia u Khong- 
thoh lehse la hiar pateng da u Syntiew.

U SYNTIEW 1676-1701

U Syntiew u long u Syiem uba donbor, u la 
pyniar bad pynheh ia la i jong i jylla barit na ba- 
roh arliang na shatei bad shathie da ka jingleit 
hiarthma ba khlem sangeh jong u, khnang ban ioh 
rah ia ka sha ka burom ba ha khlieh duh. Ka 
khanatang ka iathuh, ba dei ma u uba la pynioh ia 
ka Sohrarim bad Mawmluh na ka jaid Nongkyn- 
rihda kaba shu thied. Ki Nongkynrih ki khein 
ia u la kum u jong u Syiem. Lehse hadien ka 
jingpynioh jong u ia kine ki khyndew, u la pyn- 
iar ia la ka jong ka bor halor ka thain Shelia ka- 
ha kata ka por ka la kynthup ia ki khyndai

13

tylli ki shnong, kata ka Mustoh, ka Nongbah, 
Nongtraw, Dewsaw, Tynger, Tynrong, Nongwar 
Nongshluit bad Sheila. Ha ka jingleit tur ba 
shaduh khap shathie sharum bha u la pyniar ia 
la ka jingsynshar sha ki rithor jong ka Sylhet bad 
hangto u la seng ia kawei ka kut sbipai ha De- 
wanganj. Ka Hima Nongkhlaw ka la duh noh ia 
ki kyntoit shnong jong ka Shelia bad ka Dewan- 
ganj lehse shen shen hadien jong u Syntiew.

U Syiem Synliew ruh u la pyniar ia la ka 
jong ka jingsynshar halor ka khyndew ka shyiap 
baiar bha ha ka phang ba shatei. La ong hana 
ba u la pynioh ia ka Sohiong bad u la pyniar ia 
la ka jong ka bor halor ki Syiem jong ka Nong- 
poh. Kumta ha ka por ka jingsynshar jong u 
syntiew ka Syiemship jong ka Nongkhlaw ka la 
synshar halor ka Hima bah Hima san baiar sha- 
duh Dewanganj ha Sylhet ba shaphang shathie.

Na ka bynta ka jingiar u pud u sam naduh 
ri-lum shaduh ri-thor lehse ka la donkam ban 
pynkylla biang ia ka synshar ka khadar jong ka 
hima. Kumta u Syntiew u la thung ia u Syiem 
khynnah uba lehse u dei u Syiem Laitlyngka I 
ban synshar bad ban peit ia ki shnong rit ba sha- 
phang shathie kaba kynthup ia ka Sohrarim, ka 
Sohra, ka Mawmluh, ka Shelia bad ka Dewang- 
anj. Nalor jong ki pat u la thung ia ki arngut 
ki para kynthei jong u, ka Senglar bad ka Jem
